title: AI tool records and repeats computer tasks to automate uploads and more. #AI #Automation #Tech
description:
OpenAI introduced a new feature called record and replay, which captures a video of a user performing a task on their computer, learns the steps involved, and automates the process for future use. This allows users to simply instruct the system to repeat the task without manually executing each step again. For example, it demonstrated uploading a YouTube video by watching the initial upload process, then handling subsequent uploads autonomously by selecting files, attaching thumbnails and subtitles, and setting privacy options.

This feature leverages machine learning to transform manual routines into reusable automation skills, making repetitive digital tasks more efficient. It stands out as a practical productivity tool, reducing time and effort for users who frequently perform complex workflows on their devices. By simplifying task automation through demonstration, it caters to users who may not have coding skills but want to streamline their digital activities.

The business value lies in enhancing user experience and workflow automation, potentially increasing productivity and user engagement with OpenAI’s ecosystem. As digital tasks become more routine, such intuitive automation lowers barriers to efficiency and can attract a broader range of users seeking smarter, hands-off solutions.
